Topological Data Analysis (C2\u2194C1, C.mechanism: Persistent homology (C2) maps topological invariants from neural data (C4) to categorical structure (C1).

Stochastic Optimal Control (C3\u2194C6,.mechanism: Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation on statistical manifolds (C5) yields rational choice under uncertainty (C3).
